title: The Best Beer in the World

sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量这一使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 更多信息请访问 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Sirus Farivar is on a mission.
sentences.zh: 西鲁斯·法里瓦尔肩负着一项使命。

sentences.en: He's trying to get a case of beer called West Flateren.
sentences.zh: 他正试图搞到一箱名为“西弗莱特伦”（Westvleteren）的啤酒。

sentences.en: West Flateren.
sentences.zh: 西弗莱特伦。

sentences.en: I'm not Dutch, so I'm not 100% sure, but I think it's West Flateren.
sentences.zh: 我不是荷兰人，所以不敢百分之百确定，但我认为是西弗莱特伦。

sentences.en: It's not easy to get, but apparently it's worth it.
sentences.zh: 这酒很难买到，但显然物有所值。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: If you're a beer nerd or have a friend who's a beer nerd, you've probably heard of Belgian beers.
sentences.zh: 如果你是个啤酒发烧友，或者有朋友是啤酒发烧友，你可能听说过比利时啤酒。

sentences.en: Belgians take their beer very seriously.
sentences.zh: 比利时人对待啤酒非常认真。

sentences.en: There are about 200 breweries in a country about twice the size of the Bay Area, where I'm from.
sentences.zh: 在这个面积大约只有我老家湾区两倍大的国家里，大约有200家酿酒厂。

sentences.en: Now, amongst these Belgian breweries and Belgian ales, there's a very specific subtype, Trappist beers.
sentences.zh: 在这些比利时酿酒厂和比利时艾尔啤酒中，有一个非常独特的子类，即特拉普派啤酒（Trappist beers）。

sentences.en: Anyone who knows anything about beer will probably start to get glassy-eyed and have a warm, delicious feeling whenever they talk about them, myself included.
sentences.zh: 任何懂点啤酒的人，每当谈起它们时，眼神大概都会变得迷离，心中涌起一种温暖而美妙的感觉，我也不例外。

sentences.en: Sentences will be punctuated with superlatives and exclamations.
sentences.zh: 说话时会伴随着各种最高级的形容词和感叹词。

sentences.en: Now I'm a person just like you, but I don't actually drink beer, so I'll have to take Sirus' word for it,
sentences.zh: 我虽然和你们一样，但其实我不喝酒，所以我只能听信西鲁斯的话，

sentences.en: or the word of one of the many beer reviewers on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 或者听信YouTube上众多啤酒评论员的话。

sentences.en: It's a beautiful day.
sentences.zh: 真是美好的一天。

sentences.en: It's all dried fruit.
sentences.zh: 全是干果味。

sentences.en: It's boozy.
sentences.zh: 酒劲十足。

sentences.en: It's earthy.
sentences.zh: 有泥土气息。

sentences.en: Looks amazing.
sentences.zh: 看起来棒极了。

sentences.en: There's something almost woody and tannic about it.
sentences.zh: 它有一种近乎木质和单宁的味道。

sentences.en: There's so many flavors going on in there.
sentences.zh: 里面有太多的风味了。

sentences.en: Yes, and I think we all know what you're going to get at.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我们都知道你想表达什么。

sentences.en: This is an A+.
sentences.zh: 这是满分作品。

sentences.en: I can't give it anything less.
sentences.zh: 我给不出比这更低的评价了。

sentences.en: That's something else.
sentences.zh: 那真是非同凡响。

sentences.en: The flavor just keeps on going and going and going.
sentences.zh: 那种风味简直绵延不绝。

sentences.en: My tongue is tingling.
sentences.zh: 我的舌头在发麻。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's, it's, wow.
sentences.zh: 是啊，它，它，哇。

sentences.en: Here's what you need to know about Trappist beers.
sentences.zh: 关于特拉普派啤酒，你需要了解这些。

sentences.en: First, they're amazing.
sentences.zh: 首先，它们非常棒。

sentences.en: Second, they're made by Trappist monks.
sentences.zh: 其次，它们是由特拉普派修士酿造的。

sentences.en: These monks trace their roots to a monastery in 17th century France and have since spread out to all over the world.
sentences.zh: 这些修士的根源可以追溯到17世纪法国的一座修道院，此后传播到了世界各地。

sentences.en: The main concept behind the Trappist lifestyle is that the Abbey should be economically self-sufficient.
sentences.zh: 特拉普派生活方式背后的核心理念是修道院应该在经济上自给自足。

sentences.en: In other words, the monks should make something and sell it to the public as a way to fund the operations of the Abbey itself.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，修士们应该生产一些东西并卖给公众，以此来资助修道院本身的运作。

sentences.en: Some make cheese.
sentences.zh: 有的做奶酪。

sentences.en: Some make spirits.
sentences.zh: 有的做烈酒。

sentences.en: There's even one in Germany that makes lentil soup.
sentences.zh: 德国甚至还有一家做扁豆汤的。

sentences.en: But none of the Trappist products are nearly anywhere as famous as the beer.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何特拉普派产品能像啤酒那样出名。

sentences.en: Only seven beer-making Trappist Abbeys exiSt.
sentences.zh: 目前仅存七家酿造啤酒的特拉普派修道院。

sentences.en: Six are in Belgium and one is in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 六家在比利时，一家在荷兰。

sentences.en: The most widely available Trappist beer is Shime.
sentences.zh: 最容易买到的特拉普派啤酒是智美（Chimay）。

sentences.en: You can get it in a lot of U.S.
sentences.zh: 你可以在美国的很多地方买到它。

sentences.en: specialty grocery stores and some bars, too.
sentences.zh: 特产杂货店和一些酒吧也有卖。

sentences.en: They make over 3 million gallons of this stuff a year.
sentences.zh: 他们每年生产超过300万加仑这种啤酒。

sentences.en: By comparison, West Fladerin makes less than 4% of that volume annually.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，西弗莱特伦每年的产量不到这个数字的4%。

sentences.en: But West Fladerin, with its plain brown bottle, no label, and the only writing is on the cap.
sentences.zh: 但西弗莱特伦，用的是普通的棕色瓶子，没有标签，唯一的文字写在瓶盖上。

sentences.en: It's super cool.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了。

sentences.en: It's one of the rarest, and many say it's the best beer in the world.
sentences.zh: 它是最稀有的啤酒之一，许多人称其为世界上最好的啤酒。

sentences.en: But here's the thing about West Fladerin.
sentences.zh: 但关于西弗莱特伦，情况是这样的。

sentences.en: You can't go there and have as much beer as you want.
sentences.zh: 你不能直接去那里想喝多少就喝多少。

sentences.en: You can't even have it shipped from the Abbey.
sentences.zh: 你甚至不能让修道院直接发货给你。

sentences.en: If you want to buy beer to take with you, you have to look up the beer reservation phone number on the Abbey's website.
sentences.zh: 如果你想买啤酒带走，你必须在修道院的网站上查找啤酒预订电话号码。

sentences.en: Then you call this certain phone number during certain hours on certain days.
sentences.zh: 然后在特定的日子、特定的时间拨打这个特定的电话号码。

sentences.en: As the monks themselves warn on the site.
sentences.zh: 正如修士们自己在网站上警告的那样。

sentences.en: Please take into account that you may often get a busy signal when you call to make a reservation.
sentences.zh: 请注意，当您致电预订时，经常会遇到占线信号。

sentences.en: Due to the fact that our beer lines are overburdened, you're not the only one who is calling at that moment.
sentences.zh: 由于我们的啤酒生产线负担过重，此时此刻不止您一个人在拨打电话。

sentences.en: Due to our small-scale production, the number of telephone calls is much greater than the number of available reservations.
sentences.zh: 由于我们是小规模生产，电话呼入量远大于可提供的预订名额。

sentences.en: That means it's a matter of having a lot of patience, as well as a lot of luck.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这既需要极大的耐心，也需要极好的运气。

sentences.en: And here's what you need to understand about me.
sentences.zh: 关于我，你需要了解这一点。

sentences.en: I am totally game for this.
sentences.zh: 我完全乐意接受挑战。

sentences.en: I love being challenged as a food consumer.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢作为一名美食消费者接受挑战。

sentences.en: In fact, there's a burger place in Connecticut that claims to have invented the hamburger in America.
sentences.zh: 事实上，康涅狄格州有一家汉堡店声称他们发明了美国的汉堡。

sentences.en: And, you know, true to their century-old rules, they refuse to serve burgers with ketchup or mustard.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们坚守着百年不变的规矩，拒绝在汉堡里加番茄酱或芥末酱。

sentences.en: And they only serve it on toaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且他们只用吐司夹着卖。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I mean, if they told me that I had to do 50 jumping jacks and run around the block and then I could get a burger, I would totally do that too.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果他们告诉我必须做50个开合跳，绕着街区跑一圈才能买到一个汉堡，我绝对也会照做。

sentences.en: Anyway, back to West Fladerin.
sentences.zh: 总之，回到西弗莱特伦。

sentences.en: If you're lucky enough to talk to a monk, and yes, you do talk to a monk,
sentences.zh: 如果你足够幸运能和修士通上话，没错，确实是和修士通话，

sentences.en: To take your reservation, you have to give your license plate number and be available to come pick up your crate during the appointed time that weekend.
sentences.zh: 为了完成预订，你必须提供车牌号，并确保能在那个周末的指定时间去取货。

sentences.en: You're limited to one crate per person, per car, maximum two per car.
sentences.zh: 每人每车限购一箱，每车最多两箱。

sentences.en: And you can't buy more than one crate during a 60-day period.
sentences.zh: 而且你在60天内不能购买超过一箱。

sentences.en: Oh, and you agree not to resell the beer as well.
sentences.zh: 哦，你还得同意不转售这些啤酒。

sentences.en: For information, please see our website, www.
sentences.zh: 如需了解信息，请查看我们的网站，www。

sentences.en: You got that.
sentences.zh: 你明白了吧。

sentences.en: There is a list of several seemingly arbitrary hoops that you have to jump through if you want to buy this beer.
sentences.zh: 如果你想买这种啤酒，就必须跳过一连串看似随意的障碍。

sentences.en: This sort of thing is not unheard of.
sentences.zh: 这种事并不罕见。

sentences.en: Velvet ropes and random reward have long been imposed to create artificial scarcity into heightened demand.
sentences.zh: 天鹅绒绳索和随机奖励长期以来一直被用来制造人为的稀缺性，从而推高需求。

sentences.en: But the mainstream trend today seems to be more geared towards greater access and accommodation for customers.
sentences.zh: 但当今的主流趋势似乎更倾向于为客户提供更大的便利和适应性。

sentences.en: The new ideal is that everything is available at all times, no matter where you live.
sentences.zh: 新的理想是无论你住在哪里，一切都能随时随地获取。

sentences.en: This is the digital age, but clearly, this is not the case for the West Flader and Trappists.
sentences.zh: 这是数字时代，但显然，西弗莱特伦的特拉普派修士并非如此。

sentences.en: They're trying to make it as difficult as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图让购买变得尽可能困难。

sentences.en: No, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: They don't make it difficult.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有让事情变得困难。

sentences.en: You make it difficult.
sentences.zh: 是你们让事情变得困难了。

sentences.en: Too much people want this beer.
sentences.zh: 太多人想要这种啤酒了。

sentences.en: This is Jeff Vondenstein.
sentences.zh: 这位是杰夫·冯登斯坦。

sentences.en: He's the author of a book called Trappist, The Seven Heavenly Beers.
sentences.zh: 他是《特拉普派：七款天堂啤酒》一书的作者。

sentences.en: And he's even a brewer himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己也是一名酿酒师。

sentences.en: Until 10 years ago, you could go to the Abbey, except on Sunday,
sentences.zh: 直到10年前，你还可以去修道院，除了周日，

sentences.en: because then they don't work.
sentences.zh: 因为那天他们不工作。

sentences.en: And except on Friday, because Friday they don't work, because they don't eat Friday.
sentences.zh: 周五也不行，因为周五他们不工作，因为周五他们不进食。

sentences.en: But Saturday they were open.
sentences.zh: 但周六他们是开放的。

sentences.en: So you went there and without problems you could buy beer.
sentences.zh: 所以你去了那里，就能毫无问题地买到啤酒。

sentences.en: Not as much as you want, but normally three crates or two crates.
sentences.zh: 虽然不能想买多少就买多少，但通常能买两三箱。

sentences.en: So it was always possible.
sentences.zh: 所以那时总是买得到的。

sentences.en: But then the Americans, it's all your fault.
sentences.zh: 但后来美国人来了，这都是你们的错。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: No, the Americans said West Flader is the best beer of the world.
sentences.zh: 不，是美国人说西弗莱特伦是世界上最好的啤酒。

sentences.en: Because English is a world language, not only in the US, England, but also Scandinavian countries.
sentences.zh: 因为英语是世界语言，不仅在美国、英国，在斯堪的纳维亚国家也是如此。

sentences.en: So everywhere where they speak or understand English, they could read Beer Advocate and all those websites.
sentences.zh: 所以凡是说英语或懂英语的地方，人们都能读到《啤酒倡导者》和所有那些网站。

sentences.en: And suddenly the demand of this beer was 10 times bigger.
sentences.zh: 突然间，这种啤酒的需求量增加了10倍。

sentences.en: And that's a problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: It's not their problem.
sentences.zh: 这并不是他们的问题。

sentences.en: They brew now the same amount as they did before.
sentences.zh: 他们现在酿造的量和以前一样多。

sentences.en: Keep in mind, this was basically the first thing that Jeff said to me when I sat down with him.
sentences.zh: 请记住，这基本上是我和杰夫坐下来谈话时他说的第一件事。

sentences.en: And I sort of felt guilty, to be honest, because he was right.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我感到有点内疚，因为他是对的。

sentences.en: I'd heard about this beer for years.
sentences.zh: 我听说过这种啤酒好多年了。

sentences.en: And now that I was living within striking distance, just over the border in Germany, there was no way I was going to pass it up.
sentences.zh: 现在我住在离那儿很近的地方，就在德国边境那边，我绝不可能错过它。

sentences.en: Jeff's an older guy with a full, bushy, gray beard.
sentences.zh: 杰夫是一位上了年纪的人，留着浓密、灰白的胡子。

sentences.en: And he seems to know just about everything about beer.
sentences.zh: 他似乎对啤酒无所不知。

sentences.en: And having written about the Trappist monks, he was the closest that I was going to get to an actual monk.
sentences.zh: 而且写过关于特拉普派修士的文章，他是我能接触到的最接近真正修士的人了。

sentences.en: But Jeff, as sort of Trappist monk by proxy, outlined the main reason for putting up these obstacles to getting West Flader in.
sentences.zh: 但杰夫作为特拉普派修士的代理人，概述了设置这些获取西弗莱特伦障碍的主要原因。

sentences.en: They decided we brew the same amount as the last 40, 50 years.
sentences.zh: 他们决定我们酿造的量和过去40、50年一样多。

sentences.en: And they have enough of that.
sentences.zh: 而且他们对那个产量已经足够满意了。

sentences.en: So why must they brew more?
sentences.zh: 所以他们为什么要酿造更多呢？

sentences.en: Because you won't.
sentences.zh: 因为你们想要。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And they live between the walls of the Rebbe.
sentences.zh: 他们生活在修道院的围墙之内。

sentences.en: So for them, it's not a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以对他们来说，这根本不是问题。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, and after spending about 90 minutes at Jeff's brewery, the Glaze Toren,
sentences.zh: 带着这个想法，在杰夫的酿酒厂“格莱兹托伦”（De Struise Brouwers）待了大约90分钟后，

sentences.en: and of course, we bought some bottles to take with us,
sentences.zh: 当然，我们买了一些瓶装酒带走，

sentences.en: my three friends and I headed out to visit the famed monks of West Flader.
sentences.zh: 我和我的三个朋友出发去拜访著名的西弗莱特伦修士们。

sentences.en: Now, as we mentioned earlier, you have to order ahead if you want to buy a case of beer.
sentences.zh: 正如我们之前提到的，如果你想买一箱啤酒，必须提前预订。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Sirius didn't have any luck ordering crates,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，西鲁斯预订时运气不佳，没能订到箱装酒，

sentences.en: but he knew he could at least sample some when he got there.
sentences.zh: 但他知道至少到了那里可以尝尝鲜。

sentences.en: But what I realized as soon as my friends and I got to the Abbey is that Jeff was totally right.
sentences.zh: 但我和朋友们一到修道院就意识到，杰夫说得完全正确。

sentences.en: The Abbey is in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 修道院位于荒郊野外。

sentences.en: It's surrounded by fields and small houses, and it's way out in the western edge of Belgium,
sentences.zh: 它被田野和小房子环绕，位于比利时的最西端，

sentences.en: very close to the French border.
sentences.zh: 离法国边境非常近。

sentences.en: It's totally understandable why the monks decided to institute this new ordering system.
sentences.zh: 完全可以理解为什么修士们决定实行这种新的预订制度。

sentences.en: If hundreds of cars descended on these tiny roads all of a sudden, it would be disastrous.
sentences.zh: 如果成百上千辆汽车突然涌入这些狭窄的道路，那将是一场灾难。

sentences.en: In other words, designing this whole process to make access difficult,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，设计整个流程来增加获取难度，

sentences.en: the calling, the vehicle registration, all of it,
sentences.zh: 电话预订、车辆登记，所有这些，

sentences.en: a lot of it comes down to roads, to infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上归结于道路和基础设施问题。

sentences.en: And there are ways to solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 当然有解决问题的方法。

sentences.en: One is bigger roads.
sentences.zh: 一种是拓宽道路。

sentences.en: But they could also choose to ship the beer out to a distributor
sentences.zh: 但他们也可以选择把啤酒运给经销商，

sentences.en: and have no one visit the Abbey at all.
sentences.zh: 这样就根本不需要任何人去修道院了。

sentences.en: There are solutions, but it's clearly not a problem the monks want to solve.
sentences.zh: 解决方案是有的，但显然这不是修士们想要解决的问题。

sentences.en: I did finally get to sit down and have a beer at the cafe across the street.
sentences.zh: 我最终还是坐在街对面的咖啡馆里喝到了一杯啤酒。

sentences.en: Which until this year was the only place that was allowed to resell it,
sentences.zh: 直到今年，那里还是唯一被允许转售这种啤酒的地方，

sentences.en: although there's been a thriving blackish-gray market for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 尽管那里长期以来一直存在着一个繁荣的灰黑色市场。

sentences.en: I wish I could say that the experience was heavenly.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我能说那次体验是天堂般的享受。

sentences.en: Don't get me wrong, this beer really is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 别误会，这啤酒确实棒极了。

sentences.en: It's got a complex flavor and is obviously crafted with a lot of care and thoughtfulness.
sentences.zh: 它风味复杂，显然是经过精心酿造的，充满了巧思。

sentences.en: But the flip side of having no label,
sentences.zh: 但没有标签的另一面，

sentences.en: of having this mythology that brings people from around the world like me
sentences.zh: 这种吸引像我这样来自世界各地的人来到修道院的神秘感，

sentences.en: to this monastery,
sentences.zh: 来到这座修道院，

sentences.en: is that the relationship between customer and brewery
sentences.zh: 其代价是顾客与酿酒厂之间的关系

sentences.en: feels almost anonymous or generic.
sentences.zh: 显得几乎是匿名或大众化的。

sentences.en: It's like my friends and I could have just bought this beer off eBay
sentences.zh: 就像我和朋友们本可以从 eBay 上买到这啤酒，

sentences.en: and enjoyed it almost anywhere,
sentences.zh: 然后在任何地方享用它，

sentences.en: and it would have been basically the same experience,
sentences.zh: 体验基本上是一样的，

sentences.en: just a lot more expensive.
sentences.zh: 只是贵得多。

sentences.en: And this is a symptom of the exact same credo that makes the beer rare and exclusive.
sentences.zh: 而这正是导致啤酒稀有且昂贵的同一信条的症状。

sentences.en: Clearly the West Flader and Trappist take pride in creating something great that people enjoy.
sentences.zh: 显然，西弗莱特伦（Westvleteren）和特拉普派修道士以创造出人们喜爱的伟大产品为荣。

sentences.en: But you, the consumers of beer, are not the real customer.
sentences.zh: 但你们，啤酒消费者，并不是他们真正的顾客。

sentences.en: God is.
sentences.zh: 上帝才是。

sentences.en: The head of the Abbey says on their website,
sentences.zh: 修道院院长在他们的网站上说：

sentences.en: we are not brewers, we are monks.
sentences.zh: 我们不是酿酒师，我们是修道士。

sentences.en: We brew beer to be able to afford being monks.
sentences.zh: 我们酿造啤酒是为了维持修道士的生活。

sentences.en: This beer is not about you and me.
sentences.zh: 这啤酒不是为你我准备的。

sentences.en: They're not creating a purist mystique
sentences.zh: 他们并不是在营造一种纯粹的神秘感，

sentences.en: and challenging us to come to the monastery
sentences.zh: 并以此挑战我们来到修道院，

sentences.en: and experience their beer in a certain way.
sentences.zh: 以某种特定的方式体验他们的啤酒。

sentences.en: I am totally ready to capitulate to the monks,
sentences.zh: 我完全准备好向修道士们妥协了，

sentences.en: just like that Connecticut hamburger place.
sentences.zh: 就像对待康涅狄格州那家汉堡店一样。

sentences.en: I will do whatever they want me to do.
sentences.zh: 他们要我做什么，我就做什么。

sentences.en: I want them to know that I am on board,
sentences.zh: 我想让他们知道我完全支持，

sentences.en: that I speak their language.
sentences.zh: 我懂他们的语言。

sentences.en: But it turns out, they're not even talking to me.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，他们根本没在跟我说话。

sentences.en: As we mentioned earlier, the limited supply of West Flader and has created a pricey black market.
sentences.zh: 正如我们之前提到的，西弗莱特伦啤酒的供应有限，导致了昂贵的黑市交易。

sentences.en: As I'm recording, I searched for a case of 24 bottles of West Flader and on eBay.
sentences.zh: 录音时，我在 eBay 上搜索了一箱 24 瓶装的西弗莱特伦啤酒。

sentences.en: And the current bid is $550 plus $50 shipping.
sentences.zh: 目前的出价是 550 美元，外加 50 美元运费。

sentences.en: 23 minutes left.
sentences.zh: 还剩 23 分钟。

sentences.en: The original price paid at the Abbey was just under $50.
sentences.zh: 在修道院购买的原始价格不到 50 美元。

sentences.en: To the delight of beer aficionados worldwide,
sentences.zh: 令全世界啤酒爱好者高兴的是，

sentences.en: in spring 2012, West Flader and Beer was finally exported
sentences.zh: 2012 年春天，西弗莱特伦啤酒终于开始出口，

sentences.en: in limited edition packages of four bottles to various countries, including the U.S.
sentences.zh: 以四瓶装的限量版包装销往包括美国在内的多个国家。

sentences.en: They are called building boxes
sentences.zh: 它们被称为“建筑盒”，

sentences.en: because the proceeds are slated to go towards the expansion and renovation of the aging Abbey.
sentences.zh: 因为收益将用于扩建和翻修老旧的修道院。

sentences.en: And if you're wondering if I did an episode about rare beer and Trappist monks
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道我制作关于稀有啤酒和特拉普派修道士的这一集，

sentences.en: partially as an extended metaphor about bizarre customer service, media piracy,
sentences.zh: 是否部分是为了隐喻古怪的客户服务、媒体盗版，

sentences.en: and why I can't legally download new episodes of Game of Thrones every Sunday night,
sentences.zh: 以及为什么我不能在每周日晚上合法下载《权力的游戏》的新剧集，

sentences.en: well, you wouldn't exactly be wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你也没完全说错。

sentences.en: Come on, HBO.
sentences.zh: 拜托了，HBO。

sentences.en: Even the 17th century monks are sending their beer out in little boxes.
sentences.zh: 连 17 世纪的修道士都在用小盒子寄送啤酒了。

sentences.en: On demand.
sentences.zh: 按需提供。

sentences.en: There isn't like a little button I can click and download something.
sentences.zh: 又没有一个小按钮让我点击下载什么东西。

sentences.en: I want to pay you.
sentences.zh: 我想付钱给你们。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 拜托。

sentences.en: A Lannister always pays his debts.
sentences.zh: 兰尼斯特有债必偿。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Sarus Farvar and me, Roman Mars,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由 Sarus Farvar 和我 Roman Mars 制作，

sentences.en: with special thanks to Sean Sineko.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢 Sean Sineko。

sentences.en: We are a project of KALW 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 KALW 91.7 本地公共广播电台的项目，

sentences.en: and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 以及旧金山美国建筑师协会的项目。

sentences.en: Support for 99% Invisible is provided in part by Tiny Letter.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》的部分支持由 Tiny Letter 提供。

sentences.en: Email for people with something to say.
sentences.zh: 为有话要说的人提供的电子邮件服务。

sentences.en: My boy Carver always has something to say.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子 Carver 总是有话要说。

sentences.en: What do you have to say, Carver?
sentences.zh: 你想说什么，Carver？

sentences.en: Daddy, long legs, do you have eight legs, just look better to say they are not spiders.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，盲蛛（Daddy long legs）有八条腿，说它们不是蜘蛛看起来更好。

sentences.en: They are arachnids, but they are not spiders.
sentences.zh: 它们是蛛形纲动物，但它们不是蜘蛛。

sentences.en: That's a load off my mind.
sentences.zh: 这让我松了一口气。

sentences.en: It's free, easy, minimal, powerful, the simplest way to write an email newsletter.
sentences.zh: 它免费、简单、极简、强大，是撰写电子邮件通讯最简单的方式。

sentences.en: Online at tinyletter.com.
sentences.zh: 网址是 tinyletter.com。

sentences.en: This program is distributed by PRX, the public radio exchange,
sentences.zh: 本节目由公共广播交易所 PRX 发行，

sentences.en: making public radio more public.
sentences.zh: 让公共广播更加大众化。

sentences.en: Online at PRX.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是 PRX.org。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并点赞本节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars, but you can always just find the show online
sentences.zh: 我在 Twitter 上的账号是 Roman Mars，但你随时可以在网上找到本节目，

sentences.en: and even talk about beer if you want to.
sentences.zh: 如果你想的话，甚至可以聊聊啤酒。

sentences.en: I'll just be over here in the corner.
sentences.zh: 我就待在角落里好了。

sentences.en: I'll sip on a soda.
sentences.zh: 我喝点苏打水。

sentences.en: I'll drive.
sentences.zh: 我来开车。

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 99percentinvisible.org.
